source.primary: HipSTR v0.7 per-sample calls over the ISFG minimum range (GRCh38)
source.data: 1000 Genomes 30x (NYGC, ENA PRJEB31736): CRAM slices of the ISFG loci +-1 kb
source.regions: HGDP rerun2026 bed_isfg.bed: HipSTR regions = ISFG minimum ranges (FSSG v6.1, GRCh38). HipSTR reads the BED start as 1-based, so each region carries 1 extra 5' base; isfg_trim5_bp / isfg_trim3_bp bases of allele_seq fall outside the ISFG range and are trimmed off by coordinates.
source.notes: Allele sequences reconstructed from REF/ALT + GT. Allelic Coverage derived from PDP (fractional read support).
source.allele_designation: Allele calls = reference CE + HipSTR FORMAT GB (bp difference from GRCh38), microvariants as .{remainder_bp}. genotype_forense lists the two calls in ascending order.
source.no_call_rule: A homozygous call is not reported when any read spanning the ISFG range supports another allele (beyond +-1 repeat-unit stutter): the signature of dropout of the longer allele.

nomenclature.ranges: ISFG minimum range (FSSG v6.1 / ISFG 2024), GRCh38, BED strand '+' (isfg_seq{n} is forward)
nomenclature.fields: bracketed{n} = STRNaming name; isfg_seq{n} = exact STRNaming input over the ISFG range, all observed (isfg_ref5_bp / isfg_ref3_bp = 0); isfgSegments{n} = block colouring from STRNaming --html
nomenclature.verified: 2026-09-27: every name's CE equals the allele call; across the 5 samples the calls agree with the earlier core-region HipSTR run in 103/105 loci, the other 2 being the no-calls.
